body:
Found while executing #8075 (retirement of `data/external-lookup.zod.ts` and `system/message-queue.zod.ts` under ADR-0049). Filed unassigned; **not** fixed in the #8075 code PR because `content/docs/releases/` is release-owned and must never be edited in a code PR (AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails) — this needs a dedicated docs-only PR after the retirement lands.

Blocked-by: #8075 (the retirement PR; branch `claude/issue-8075-retire-dead-credential-schemas`)

## What is stale (file:line on the #8075 branch, unchanged from `origin/main`)

`content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx`:

1. Line ~462 (Data layer summary row): "document/mapping/external-lookup still pending" — after #8075 the external-lookup protocol is not pending, it is retired (route 3, `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[17]`, D3 `external-lookup-message-queue-families-retired`).
2. Line ~474 (remaining-gaps paragraph): "the mapping/document/external-lookup data protocols" — same staleness; external-lookup should leave the pending list, and the paragraph may deserve a note that the protocol was retired rather than implemented.

Worth checking in the same docs pass: whether the page describes the system message-queue protocol anywhere (the same #8075 change retired `system/message-queue.zod.ts`; the live MQ surface is kernel's `EventMessageQueueConfig`).
